designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Cape May National Wildlife Refuge by administrative action.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 (16 U.S.C. 742f)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cape May National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Cape May National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 1399): "The Cape May National Wildlife Refuge was created on January 20, 1989 administratively under authority of the Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956"
